records.text: Approved: the README architecture graphic, reviewed independently at exact head 6aa38a36e2e7140c089ccf39ad1e92ebc87aef9c in a clean detached worktree; both cited exact-head artifacts (docs/assets/tailapp-architecture.svg and README.md). Verified against the conditions: the SVG is well-formed (xmllint --noout passes) and accessible — role=img with aria-labelledby referencing a <title> and a <desc> that accurately narrate the pipeline. It is accurate to the architecture: external OTLP/HTTP enters one local resident; a single bounded Tailapp contains the required tiles — normalize.jsonata (normalization), otel_event (the private event), fold.jsonata (analytic fold), the SQLite projection, and the DDL/JSONata source tiles (application.sql event DDL and table DDL, normalize.jsonata and fold.jsonata) — and MCP (query and manage) reads toward the projection tables, matching the OTLP-in / MCP-query endpoints; the footer states the true invariant that one resident hosts many isolated Tailapps each following the fixed two-stage path. The viewBox (1400x480) is a sensible README-width aspect, the layout is simple and balanced, and a system-font fallback stack is declared so it renders without Inter present. The image is embedded in README.md immediately before the Try it section with descriptive alt text. git diff --check reports no whitespace errors, and the full battery at the exact head passes: go test ./... 13 packages ok, go test -race ./... zero failures, go vet clean, scripts/demo.sh passes; tree clean. No required changes; no advisories. (Note: this commit is stacked on the clarification a498991 whose review #1056 is held pending builder retiring the duplicate self-request #1047; that does not affect the correctness of this graphic at its exact head.)
